$comment: Overlay of the upstream 'benchmark' port. Upstream's portfile passes -Werror=old-style-cast through vcpkg_cmake_configure(OPTIONS ...), which lands on CMake's own command line rather than the compiler's. CMake <= 4.3 ignored the unknown warning category; CMake >= 4.4 rejects it, so the port fails to configure. Remove this overlay once the upstream port drops that flag.
name: benchmark
description: A library to benchmark code snippets, similar to unit tests.
